text: It returns an error: `echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, i.(error).Error())` — i.e. it type-asserts the pooled value to `error` and wraps its message in a 500 HTTPError (middleware/decompress.go, in the `GZIPEncoding` case).
It returns the number of bytes read `n` together with `echo.ErrStatusRequestEntityTooLarge` (the 413 error) — i.e. `return n, echo.ErrStatusRequestEntityTooLarge` once `r.read > r.limit`.
`DefaultBodyDumpConfig.Skipper` is `DefaultSkipper` (the package-level default skipper that never skips).
`DefaultGzipConfig.Skipper` (i.e. the package default `DefaultSkipper`) — note it takes it from DefaultGzipConfig, not DefaultDecompressConfig.
